The '''1980–81 Football League Cup''' was the 21st season of the [[EFL Cup|Football League Cup]], a knockout competition for England's top 92 football clubs. The competition started on 8 August 1980 and ended with the [[1981 Football League Cup Final|final]] replay on 1 April 1981.

The final was contested by [[1980–81 Football League#First Division|First Division]] team [[Liverpool F.C.|Liverpool]] and [[1980–81 Football League Second Division|Second Division]] [[West Ham United F.C.|West Ham United]] at [[Wembley Stadium (1923)|Wembley Stadium]] in [[London]] and the replay was played at [[Villa Park]] in [[Birmingham]].
